title: Bial Foundation as the biggest funder of parapsychology

tellings.quote: the biggest funding Agency for parapsychology is the BL foundation in Portugal portug B um and about half their grants go to parapsychology

plain: The biggest funder of parapsychology anywhere is the Bial Foundation in Portugal, according to the researcher Rupert Sheldrake, and he says about half of its grants go to the field. Sheldrake tells Michels this as something he knows from his own work, without pointing to a source.
